text: Every emitted semantic dependency shall have an explicit edge, including calls, fnaddr, global access, address constants, helpers, types, and machine labels. Relocations shall imply their targets; other dependencies shall be separate edges from the containing definition. Disassembly shall not substitute for missing producer metadata.
